name: SimpleFin Sync
description: Automatically import bank and credit-card transactions from SimpleFin, with correct balances, pending reconciliation, and internal-transfer linking.

release.notes: Fixes the emoji picker, which rendered but was clipped out of existence by ancestor containers using overflow:hidden — it is now positioned in viewport coordinates from the button's own rect. Includes 1.8.0's collapsible budget groups (Needs, Wants, Savings, ...) read live from Wealthfolio, so groups and categories added there appear automatically.
